$comment: Every environment-specific value the kit needs lives here. Nothing is hardcoded
in lib/. Copy this file, point `environments` at your own hosts, and adjust the
selectors/navigation block to match your SmartClient application's shell.
Credentials never go in this file -- use .env or CAPTURE_USER / CAPTURE_PASS.

app.$comment: Paths are appended to an environment's origin. Defaults suit a CAS-fronted app.

$comment: columnLabels: grid column headers whose VALUES are always covered.
labelPatterns: field/column labels whose adjacent value is covered.
valuePatterns: regular expressions (source strings) matched against leaf text.
requireBoxes: minimum regions that must be found and verified, or the capture aborts.
identityPrefix: the logged-in-user badge in the top bar.

guard.$comment: Left-clicks whose control label matches any term are cancelled in the capture phase.

$comment: menuLabel/adminLabel: the shell's top-level menu entries.
adminMenuItemPixel: the ONE fixed-position pixel click the benchmark found safe.
tabBarY: y of the admin tab strip; tabs: labels treated as tabs rather than list items.
paths: named 'A > B > C' routes so scripts never embed a route inline.
tiers: order of the resolution cascade. Drop 'vlm' to guarantee no capture ever
leaves this machine -- the vision tier uploads a screenshot to vision.command.
tesseractCandidates: absolute paths to try before falling back to PATH. Tesseract is
often installed without being on PATH. ${ENVVAR} is expanded, e.g.
"${LOCALAPPDATA}/Programs/Tesseract-OCR/tesseract.exe". TESSERACT_BIN wins over this.
templateDir: reference crops for the template-match tier. None ship with the kit;
they are screenshots of your application, so .gitignore blocks them.
vision: an external CLI that accepts an image, a JSON schema, and a prompt on stdin.
null command disables the tier. Placeholders in args: {root} {image} {schema} {out}.
Optional command run when every resolver tier misses a target, to surface docs about
the unclear term before the run halts. null just hard-stops. The term is appended to
args unless one of them contains {term}.
Optional coding-agent CLI handed a FAILURE-*.json for diagnosis. null disables it, and
it only fires when CAPTURE_AGENT_HANDOFF=1. Placeholders: {root} {out} {image} {report}.
imageArgs are appended only when the failure screenshot exists; stdinSentinel is the
argument that tells the CLI to read the prompt from stdin.
